details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has initiated an advance notice of proposed rulemaking for "Regulation CTX" and "Regulation CAM." These proposals aim to establish a federal regulatory framework for leveraged retail crypto asset transactions and crypto asset markets, a move to bring clarity and prevent fraud after previous legislative efforts failed. The public has a 60-day window to provide comments.
title: CFTC Proposes New Rules for Leveraged Retail Crypto Trading

details: Ethereum's "Glamsterdam" upgrade has successfully launched on the Sepolia testnet, marking a critical step in its 2026 scaling roadmap. This deployment is testing a significantly increased gas limit of 200 million, more than triple the prior 60 million, alongside new features like enshrined proposer-builder separation. These changes aim to enhance block processing and Layer 1 capacity, moving the network closer to its mainnet activation.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Live on Sepolia Testnet, Tests 200M Gas Limit

details: On October 6th, Bitcoin experienced a rapid decline of almost $2,000 in approximately 20 minutes, leading to the liquidation of nearly $400 million in leveraged long positions across the crypto market. The price dropped from around $71,765 to $67,895, hitting its lowest point since April. Total liquidations within 24 hours surpassed $1 billion, predominantly affecting long bets, attributed to technical breakdowns and broader macroeconomic pressures.
title: Bitcoin Plunges Nearly $2,000, $400 Million in Longs Liquidated

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) collectively saw net inflows totaling $118.8 million on October 6th, reversing a previous day's outflow. BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) was the primary driver, attracting $122 million in inflows. This renewed interest from investors suggests a positive sentiment and fresh capital entering Bitcoin via regulated investment vehicles.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs Record $118.8M Net Inflows

details: Ethereum spot ETFs registered a substantial net outflow of $202 million on October 6th, marking the sixth consecutive day of such movements. BlackRock's ETHA fund alone accounted for the entirety of this daily outflow. Despite this recent trend, the cumulative net inflows for Ethereum spot ETFs since their inception remain robust at $13.549 billion.
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Experience $202M Net Outflow

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin outlined his long-term vision for the network by 2028, predicting a substantial increase in transaction capacity, reduced costs, and enhanced privacy features. Buterin emphasized the potential for Artificial Intelligence (AI) integration to fundamentally transform applications on the blockchain, indicating a forthcoming transformative phase expected to attract more developers and users and strengthen Ethereum's market position.
title: Vitalik Buterin Reveals Ethereum's 2028 Vision: Scaling & AI Integration

details: According to analyst Dennis Liu (VirtualBacon), a broad "altcoin season" has not yet materialized, despite recent rallies observed in specific altcoins like Zcash and Quant. Liu points out that the average altcoin has only outperformed Bitcoin by about 10% since Bitcoin's bottom, and the current gains are too isolated to signify a widespread rotation into altcoins. The broader altcoin market has also shown signs of a "risk-off" sentiment.
title: Analyst: Altcoin Season Has Not Yet Begun Despite Isolated Rallies

details: Solana has launched an open-source Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) program aimed at institutional clients. This program enables the simultaneous settlement of both the asset and cash legs of a trade, striving for transaction finality in mere seconds, a significant improvement over traditional 1-2 day clearing cycles. This development enhances efficiency and strengthens Solana's appeal for institutional adoption.
title: Solana Unveils DvP Program for Institutional Crypto Settlement

details: The Winklevoss twins have submitted an application for a spot Zcash (ZEC) Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF), signaling growing institutional interest in privacy-focused digital assets. This filing coincides with Zcash's recent price appreciation, highlighting its performance as one of the top-gaining cryptocurrencies over the past year.
title: Winklevoss Files for Spot Zcash ETF as ZEC Price Climbs
